purpose: Small follow-up to keep multi-source support items from being falsely assigned to a single elective region.

recommended_unlocks.name: Demon horn necklace
recommended_unlocks.effect: Daemonheim reward; restores Prayer when qualifying remains are processed

recommended_unlocks.name: Attuned ectoplasmator
recommended_unlocks.effect: Processes supported ashes/ghost remains and can feed Dungeoneering prayer-necklace sustain

recommended_unlocks.name: Player-owned Slayer Dungeon route
recommended_unlocks.effect: Optional Sunken Pyramid route after capturing abyssal beast souls; Wilderness remains the direct Forinthry route

alternate_region_routes.requirements: Captured abyssal beast souls and the Player-owned Slayer Dungeon setup

set.dependency_note: Forinthry is the direct Wilderness route. Desert is an optional Player-owned Slayer Dungeon route. The attuned ectoplasmator itself has multiple acquisition/recharge sources and is not hard-assigned to either region.
